protocol_findings.title: Anonymous Broker Access
protocol_findings.description: MQTT broker at 127.0.0.1:1883 accepts anonymous connections. Any client can subscribe to all topics including command channels.
protocol_findings.remediation: Enable authentication. Set allow_anonymous false in mosquitto.conf.

protocol_findings.title: $SYS Topic Information Leakage
protocol_findings.description: Broker version and client stats exposed via $SYS/# to unauthenticated clients.

protocol_findings.title: Retained Message Poisoning
protocol_findings.description: Unauthenticated client successfully published retained message to commands/actuator.
protocol_findings.remediation: Implement publish ACLs. Validate retained message origin.

stride_threats.title: Agent Identity Spoofing via MQTT Client ID
stride_threats.mitigation: Enforce mutual TLS (mTLS). Validate client certificates. Use unique per-agent credentials. Enable MQTT ACLs.

stride_threats.title: Behavioral Clone — Agent Impersonation
stride_threats.mitigation: Use ABFP payload entropy analysis to detect anomalies even when timing matches. Implement payload signing (HMAC).

stride_threats.title: Retained Message Poisoning
stride_threats.mitigation: Restrict publish ACLs on command topics. Validate message schema server-side. Monitor retained messages with ABFP scanner.

stride_threats.title: Will Message Hijacking
stride_threats.mitigation: Restrict will topic permissions. Validate will payloads against expected schema.

stride_threats.title: Unauthenticated Topic Enumeration
stride_threats.mitigation: Disable anonymous access. Restrict wildcard subscriptions. Enable TLS for all connections.

stride_threats.title: MQTT Broker Flood via Burst Publishing
stride_threats.mitigation: Configure per-client rate limits on broker. Use ABFP burst detection to alert on abnormal publish rates.

stride_threats.title: Topic Privilege Escalation
stride_threats.mitigation: Enforce strict topic ACLs per agent role. Use ABFP TOPIC_ESCALATION flag to detect and alert.

stride_threats.title: RabbitMQ Default Credential Escalation
stride_threats.mitigation: Disable guest user. Create role-specific accounts. Restrict management API to localhost.
